story_text.value:
BongBong is a fast-paced tank shooter game inspired by the NES tank shooters from 80's/90's that I used to play with my neighbour when I was a kid.

I wanted to give my kids the amazing feeling of building worlds - and then fighting in them. Keeping things "pixelated" but equally entertaining and realistic.

Geme is written in Rust and uses Raylib as the backbone, with the Rapier physics engine and HECS for ECS.

It is compiled to WASM for browsers and runs on iOS, macOS, Android, Windows and Linux. There is also a coop, so u can play with other friends across platforms.

I'm trying to polish it enough to release it to the Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and other stores.

It is not a "one-shot" game, but it is built using AI and agentic workflows. But most importantly, it is fun to play and to build.

Feedback appreciated!

title.value: Show HN: BongBong – A tank shooter and world builder

story_text.value:
EtherPK (https://app.etherpk.com) now lets you edit a Markdown table in place, WYSIWYG style. You can click a cell and type, and the table stays a table.

Until now, EtherPK drew a table as a grid only while you weren't editing it. Placing the the cursor in one and it turned back into Markdown text, showing a block of pipes and dashes with cell content, which was tricky to edit and read as a table.

You can now edit cell content, add and remove rows and columns without having to work with the plain markdown text behind it. If you do still want to access the plain markdown, the table context menu enables access.

Full markdown editor table management adds a great new capability to an already fast, capable markdown editor in EtherPK. Note that EtherPK is not limited to working with its own graph structure EtherPK can now work as a general purpose markdown editor in plain folder mode.

title.value: Show HN: EtherPK has a new Markdown table editor
